capabilities: Show each embedded note as a row with its headings nested under the heading that holds the embed
Jump to a heading by clicking a row, including inside embeds, and fold rows
Highlight the section currently at the top of the note while scrolling
Search the outline for headings, callout titles, list headings and embed names
Copy the outline as a Markdown list of links, with word counts and broken-embed marks in Pro
extras: Freemium: nested embeds, word counts, broken-embed marks and Markdown copy are Pro-only, unlocked via GitHub Sponsors with device-flow sign-in. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+; tested on desktop only, not mobile. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be disabled). Free tier caps at 400 notes and 5,000 rows.
intentEvidence: Does it replace the core Outline? No. Both can be open at the same time.
problem: The core Outline shows only the open note's own headings, so headings inside embedded notes, callout titles, and headings written in list items never appear in one place.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($15 once or $5/month) for Pro features

summary: Sidebar outline panel that lists headings of the open note and of the notes it embeds, plus callout titles and headings in list items.
